settings.terms_conditions_subtitle: Review the app's terms of use
settings.delete_account_dialog_message: Your account will be permanently deleted and you'll be signed out. This action can't be undone.
settings.terms_section1_body: This app is intended for use only by authorized staff at the branch. Your login credentials must not be shared with anyone else.
settings.terms_section2_body: Every action taken through your account — orders, payments, treasury transactions — is recorded under your name and is your responsibility. Please sign out when leaving the device.
settings.terms_section3_body: Customer data, such as name and phone number, entered in the app is used only to track the branch's deferred accounts and is not used for any other purpose.
settings.terms_section4_body: Branch management reserves the right to review, modify, or revoke any account's permissions at any time, and to review the activity log for accounting and audit purposes.
settings.terms_section5_body: These terms may be updated from time to time. Continuing to use the app after an update constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.
settings.about_section1_body: Cafe cash is a complete point-of-sale system for cafés and coffee shops, helping the team manage orders, tables, seats, payments, and the treasury from one place.
settings.about_section2_body: The app is built for the branch's own team — cashiers and management — and isn't a customer-facing app.
settings.about_section3_body: Hall and seating management, real-time order and payment tracking, shift and treasury management, plus deferred customer account tracking.
settings.about_section4_body: This app is developed and maintained by Matrix as a customizable white-label solution for any branch or café chain.
settings.privacy_section1_body: Staff account data (name and phone number), the activity you record — orders, payments, treasury transactions — and deferred-account customer data (name and phone number) entered within the branch.
settings.privacy_section2_body: This data is used only to run the branch's daily operations — recording orders, tracking deferred accounts, and generating shift and treasury reports. It is never used for marketing purposes.
settings.privacy_section3_body: Operational data — orders, treasury, customers — is stored on the branch's own device. Only your staff account data syncs with the server, for sign-in purposes.
settings.privacy_section4_body: The app never shares your data or the branch's customer data with any third party, and each branch's data is fully isolated from every other branch.
settings.privacy_section5_body: You can ask branch management to review or delete your personal data at any time. Deleting your account from the Settings page immediately clears your local session.
